subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella remain open until both guarded cron base-session cleanup and high-frequency/context warning policy are resolved, or should it be narrowed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 plus its repair PR?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the complete requested outcome spans compatibility-sensitive session cleanup and operator-facing cadence/context guardrail policy.

options.title: Keep Coordinated Umbrella
options.body: Track the guarded retention fix and the cadence/context warning decision here before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow To Retention
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194 as the canonical retention path, then split remaining warning ideas separately.

options.title: Defer Guardrails
options.body: Land only the retention cleanup and leave cadence or context warnings to future docs/product work.

recommendation.title: Keep Coordinated Umbrella
recommendation.body: Track the guarded retention fix and the cadence/context warning decision here before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history signal for session maintenance and cron retention behavior.
